metaDescription: See how an EasyGoSpa home massage looks — at home, in a condo or in your hotel room across Metro Manila.
title: Home Massage, Wherever You Are
lead: A look at how a session comes to you — at home, in a condo or in your hotel room.

pick.title: Choose Your Therapist
pick.alt: The EasyGoSpa app therapist page: Mia is available now and ID-verified; Swedish Massage, 90 minutes, ₱1,200 selected

book.title: Book
book.alt: The EasyGoSpa app booking review: therapist Mia, 1.7 km away, Swedish Massage for 90 minutes and the visit address

depart.title: Your Therapist Sets Off
depart.alt: The EasyGoSpa app booking progress screen: Mia is on the way, with her arrival time and distance

arrive.title: At Your Door
arrive.alt: Therapist Mia smiling at a hotel room door with the green EasyGoSpa bag and towels

massage.title: The Massage Begins
massage.alt: A therapist warming massage oil between her palms

rate.title: Rate Your Therapist
rate.alt: The EasyGoSpa app rating screen: five stars for Mia

swedish.alt: Massage oil pouring from an amber bottle into a brass dish, with a folded towel and an olive sprig

deep.alt: A therapist’s hands resting flat on a folded towel, olive piping on the uniform cuffs

thai.alt: An ivory cotton floor mat on a wooden floor with a round bolster, a folded towel and an olive sprig — no oil

shiatsu.alt: A therapist pressing her thumb into a folded towel, fingers relaxed — no oil

stone.alt: Three warm dark massage stones on a folded towel, one resting in a brass dish

aroma.alt: Two essential-oil bottles and a bowl of oil with floating olive leaves, beside an olive branch

ctaText: Book now and your therapist comes to your home, condo or hotel. Pay in cash when they arrive.
